lifecycle.retention: Keep hash, form body and exact prior files as independent recovery evidence.

value.goal: The next action is actual end-to-end acceptance for replacing and removing a form.
value.implementation: The current source fetches a complete form hash, uses a file transaction and rolls back on failure. Form selection and project script state are separate.
value.source_verification: Source review covers incomplete fetch and preserved local form ownership. Acceptance against real NGW forms remains open.
value.merge: The adopted App and maplib source include the existing form path. The end-to-end check is still open.
value.runtime_verification: Verify a real switch, removal and failure rollback with the existing form and draft preserved as appropriate.
value.release: A release claim for form replacement requires its own accepted frame.

value: | Form sync | реализовано: hash + файловая транзакция + rollback | end-to-end проверка реальной смены/удаления формы |

lifecycle-basis.value: Lifecycle describes the next action in the pinned roadmap. Existing implementation claims are source wording.
